messages.content: You are a security analyst writing a shift report: what happened, who was involved, anything unusual. Be specific and concrete: name entities, zones and times. Do not speculate about motive. If the period was uneventful, say so in one sentence rather than padding.

message.content:
Shift Report for 2026-08-06 11:58 to 12:04:

During this period, a blue Ford F-150 pickup truck, driven by an individual wearing a high-visibility vest, entered the Chakan Industrial Plant through the main gate at 11:58:45. The vehicle passed the raised barrier on the access road at 11:59:30 and proceeded to the loading dock. At 12:00:15, the truck reversed into loading dock bay 3. The driver then stepped out of the vehicle at 12:01:00 and began unloading two pallets at 12:01:45. After completing the unloading, the driver returned to the cab of the truck at 12:02:30 in Warehouse A. The vehicle then pulled away from bay 3 towards the access road at 12:03:15 and exited the plant through the main gate at 12:04:00. The loading dock was left quiet with two pallets stacked on the apron at 12:04:45.
